description:
We're Hiring — Manager, Retailing Platform @ factori.com (2 positions)
   


**If you can hold a room of 200 small\-business owners on a webinar and leave them with something they'll actually use to grow — we want to talk to you.** 




**Company:** 
 Sushine Exports Private Limited (factori.com)
 



**Location:** 
 Headquarters at Bannerughatta, Bengaluru (on\-site, full\-time)
 



**Reports to:** 
 Founder \& CEO
 



**Openings:** 
 2
 



**Experience:** 
 4–8 years across digital marketing, e\-commerce, or business consulting/training.
 **Compensation:** 
 Up to ₹8 LPA, based on qualifications, experience, and current CTC.
 



  




 About factori.com
 
 Welcome to
 **factori.com — The Factory for the World.** 




 factori.com is a global manufacturing and commerce platform that connects
 **500\+ partner manufacturers across India** 
 with business buyers, brands, institutions, and entrepreneurs worldwide. Our vision is to onboard
 **100,000\+ manufacturers globally by 2030\.** 




 One of our three core offerings is
 **retailing.factori.com** 
 — a plug\-and\-play platform that lets any entrepreneur launch their own e\-commerce store in 30 minutes, on their own domain, with instant access to thousands of ready\-to\-ship products. Thousands of retailers are already live on it — and our goal is to make every one of them successful.
 



  




 About the role
 
 Thousands of entrepreneurs — homemakers, students, first\-time founders, side\-hustlers — have launched their own online stores on retailing.factori.com. What most of them need next isn't more features. It's someone who teaches them how to sell.
 



 That's this role. You'll be the growth teacher and business consultant for our active retailer community — running high\-quality webinars week after week, and helping retailers turn their stores into real, growing businesses. Your success is measured in one place:
 **the sales growth of the retailers you coach.** 




  




 What you'll own1\. Webinars — your main stage
 * Design and run a regular calendar of webinars for active retailers on: digital marketing, social media marketing, performance marketing, community marketing, and running an e\-commerce business.
* Make them practical — every session ends with steps a retailer can execute on their store the same day.


 2\. Business consulting for retailers
 * Go beyond broadcast: consult with retailers on their specific store, category, pricing, and promotion challenges.
* Diagnose why a store isn't selling and prescribe the fix — traffic, catalogue, pricing, promotion, or persistence.


 3\. Driving retailer sales
 * Own the number that matters: more orders per active retailer, month on month.
* Track which retailers attend, what they implement, and what moved — double down on what works.


 4\. Content that compounds
 * Turn your best sessions into repeatable playbooks, guides, and recorded content the whole retailer base can use.



  




 What we're looking forMust\-have
 * **Hands\-on digital marketing depth** 
 — you've actually run social media, performance, or e\-commerce campaigns, not just talked about them.
* **A natural teacher and presenter** 
 — you can hold an audience on a live webinar, explain marketing to a first\-time entrepreneur in plain language, and enjoy doing it.
* **Business consulting instinct** 
 — you can look at a small online store and quickly see what's blocking its sales.
* **Comfort with scale and repetition** 
 — multiple sessions a week, every week, at a consistently high standard.
* Fluent English; Hindi and/or Kannada a strong advantage for our retailer base.


 Nice\-to\-have
 * Experience training, coaching, or consulting for SMEs, D2C brands, or seller communities (e.g., marketplace seller\-education teams, agency training roles, ed\-tech instruction).
* Your own content presence — a channel, page, or community you've grown.
* Familiarity with e\-commerce storefront tools, SEO basics, and WhatsApp\-led selling.


 What you get
 * **Up to ₹8 LPA** 
 CTC, basis qualifications, experience and current CTC.
* **Reports directly to the Founder \& CEO** 
 — this is a flagship initiative, not a side project.
* A live audience of thousands of retailers from day one — your teaching shows up in real businesses growing.
* Full ownership of the webinar and retailer\-education engine at a fast\-scaling platform.

title: Client Success Executive
description:
Esthète Creations is a creative branding and digital marketing agency focused on building impactful brand experiences through strategy, design, content, performance marketing, and digital execution.

We work with brands across education, healthcare, fashion, study abroad, and other growth\-focused industries.

Role Overview

We are looking for a proactive and professionally driven **Client Success Manager** to take ownership of client relationships and ensure the successful execution of their marketing activities.

The role involves understanding client objectives, coordinating with internal creative and marketing teams, managing timelines and deliverables, handling communication and approvals, and ensuring that clients receive consistent value from our services.

The ideal candidate should be comfortable working between **clients, strategy, creativity, and execution**.

Key ResponsibilitiesClient Management

* Act as the primary point of contact for assigned clients.
* Build and maintain strong, professional relationships with clients.
* Understand client business objectives, requirements, expectations, and challenges.
* Maintain regular communication and ensure clients are updated on project progress.
* Handle client feedback, concerns, revisions, and escalations professionally.
* Conduct client meetings and discussions whenever required.

Account \& Campaign Management

* Take ownership of assigned client accounts from planning to execution.
* Coordinate monthly content calendars, campaigns, social media activities, and marketing initiatives.
* Understand campaign objectives and ensure the internal team is aligned with them.
* Track account\-level deliverables, timelines, approvals, and dependencies.
* Ensure projects are delivered within agreed timelines and quality expectations.
* Proactively identify delays, gaps, or potential issues and resolve them before they affect delivery.

Internal Team Coordination

* Coordinate with designers, content creators, video editors, performance marketers, developers, and other internal teams.
* Convert client requirements into clear and actionable briefs.
* Ensure internal teams have the required information, references, timelines, and priorities.
* Follow up on tasks and maintain execution discipline.
* Review work before it reaches the client to ensure it meets the brief and expected standards.
* Coordinate revisions and ensure feedback is implemented accurately.

Strategy \& Creative Coordination

* Understand the client's brand, target audience, positioning, and marketing objectives.
* Participate in campaign brainstorming and contribute relevant ideas.
* Work with the creative and strategy teams to develop campaign concepts and content directions.
* Present creative ideas, campaign proposals, and marketing plans to clients when required.
* Identify opportunities to improve the client's digital presence and marketing performance.

Client Retention \& Growth

* Monitor client satisfaction and proactively address concerns.
* Build long\-term relationships with assigned accounts.
* Identify opportunities for additional services based on client requirements.
* Support account growth through cross\-selling and upselling relevant agency services.
* Understand client performance and communicate meaningful opportunities for improvement.
* Contribute towards client retention and long\-term account value.

Reporting \& Documentation

* Maintain proper records of client communication, requirements, approvals, and deliverables.
* Coordinate monthly reports and performance discussions with relevant teams.
* Track pending approvals, payments, deliverables, and other account\-level requirements.
* Maintain updated account information and project status.

What We’re Looking For

* 2–4 years of experience in **client servicing, account management, digital marketing, advertising, social media, or a creative agency**.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong client relationship and people\-management skills.
* Good understanding of digital marketing and social media.
* Understanding of content creation, branding, design, video, and paid advertising workflows.
* Strong project coordination and follow\-up skills.
* Ability to manage multiple clients and deadlines simultaneously.
* Good presentation and negotiation skills.
* Strong problem\-solving and decision\-making ability.
* Ability to work independently and take ownership of assigned accounts.
* Proactive attitude with strong attention to detail.

Good to Have

* Experience working in a creative/digital marketing agency.
* Experience managing multiple brand accounts.
* Knowledge of Meta Ads and Google Ads.
* Understanding of social media analytics and campaign performance.
* Experience preparing or presenting marketing strategies.
* Familiarity with project management and communication tools.

Pay: ₹15,000\.00 \- ₹30,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Paid time off

Work Location: In person

title: Senior Analyst, Business Operations
description:
Razorpay is one of India’s leading full\-stack financial technology companies, powering the way businesses move, manage, and grow money. Founded in 2014 by Harshil Mathur and Shashank Kumar with a simple vision \- to simplify payments for Indian businesses \- we’ve since grown into a fintech powerhouse driving India’s digital payment revolution.
   

  

 Razorpay powers millions of businesses with a smarter, scalable stack that goes beyond transactions to help them truly build and grow.
   

  

 From building AI\-native agentic payments, to AI\-assisted fraud detection and real\-time risk intelligence to automated reconciliation, smart payouts, and predictive financial insights, we are embedding intelligence across our stack to make money movement faster, safer, and more efficient. In close collaboration with ecosystem partners \- including banks, networks, regulators \- we are pioneering industry\-first solutions that are shaping the next era of fintech
   

  

 Across India, Singapore and Malaysia, our products span everything from seamless checkouts to payroll automation \- powering a fintech ecosystem that’s redefining how money moves across Asia.
   

  

 Today, that ecosystem supports everyone from early\-stage startups to some of India’s largest enterprises, enabling them to accept, process, and disburse payments at scale while expanding into new ways of managing money more efficiently.
   

  

 Our scale speaks volumes: Razorpay processes $180\+ billion in annualized transactions, powering leading businesses like Airbnb, Facebook, WhatsApp, Airtel, CRED, BookmyShow, Zomato, Swiggy, Lenskart, Mirae Asset Capital markets, Indian Oil, National Pension Scheme \- and over 100 of India’s unicorns. With strong roots in India and growing operations in Southeast Asia, we are shaping the next chapter of financial technology across the region.
   

  

 We are backed by global investors including GIC, Peak XV Partners (formerly Sequoia Capital India \& SEA), Tiger Global, Ribbit Capital, Matrix Partners, MasterCard, and Salesforce Ventures, having raised over $740 million to date. Strategic acquisitions \- including Ezetap (POS and offline payments), Curlec (Malaysia expansion), BillMe (digital invoicing), and POP (rewards\-first UPI) \- along with earlier moves in fraud prevention, payroll, and lending, have further strengthened our platform and widened our footprint across Asia.
   

  

 But what truly sets Razorpay apart is our culture. At Razorpay, ownership is our oxygen \- you own what you build, with no micromanagement or red tape, just the runway to make your ideas fly. Learning is a lifestyle \- if you’re curious, you’ll feel at home here. People \> Pedigree \- we hire for attitude, hustle, and hunger more than degrees. Transparency thrives over titles \- this is where interns question CXOs and CXOs say “thank you.” Guided by our values of Customer First, Autonomy \& Ownership, Agility with Integrity, Transparency, Challenging the status quo and a strong belief that Razorpay grows with Razors, you’ll be part of a 3000\+ strong team building not just products, but the financial infrastructure of the future.
   

  

**The Role**
 We are looking for a proactive and detail\-oriented Associate, Customer Success Partner to support day\-to\-day merchant operations and deliver outstanding customer experience. The ideal candidate will assist in resolving merchant queries, ensuring smooth transaction flows, and coordinating with cross\-functional teams for timely issue resolution. A basic understanding of payment methods and reconciliation processes will be an added advantage. This role is a great opportunity for someone who is eager to learn and grow in the fintech/customer success space.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* End\-to\-End Ownership of Merchant Issues:
+ Handle complex or high\-value merchant concerns, ensuring timely and satisfactory resolution with minimal follow\-ups.

* Escalation Management:
+ Take ownership of L2/L3 escalations, coordinate with cross\-functional teams (Product, Risk, Tech, FinOps), and ensure root cause identification and resolution.

* Workflow Optimization \& SOP Design:
+ Identify gaps in current processes and contribute to the creation or improvement of SOPs to enhance resolution efficiency and merchant experience.

* Merchant Communication \& Stakeholder Alignment:
+ Maintain clear and professional communication with merchants and internal stakeholders to keep all parties informed on resolution progress.

* Operational Reporting \& Metrics Tracking:
+ Track SLAs, TATs, and resolution quality metrics; generate reports for leadership to monitor performance and identify bottlenecks.

* Mentorship \& Peer Support:
+ Guide and mentor junior associates, conduct case reviews, and ensure adherence to quality and tone standards.

* Special Projects \& Initiatives:
+ Lead or contribute to strategic projects such as refund pattern analysis, feature enablement audits, or new payment flow adoption.

* Product Feedback Loop:
+ Identify and relay recurring merchant feedback or product issues to the product/tech teams for prioritization.

* Audit Readiness \& Compliance:
+ Ensure all customer interactions, tickets, and resolutions are properly documented to support internal or regulatory audits.


**Required Skills \& Qualifications**
* Education : Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Operations, or a related field.
* Experience : Minimum 2–3 years of experience in customer service, operations, or a similar domain.
* Knowledge of Payment Ecosystem : Familiarity with UPI, Net Banking, Card Payments, eNACH, settlement processes, and refund mechanisms.


 Razorpay believes in and follows an equal employment opportunity policy that doesn't discriminate on gender, religion, sexual orientation, colour, nationality, age, etc. We welcome interests and applications from all groups and communities across the globe.
   

  

 Follow us on LinkedIn \& Twitter

title: Category Lead, Sports
description:
**Who we are** 




 Openhouse is building a new\-age learning ecosystem for children, bringing high\-quality
 



 learning experiences across academics, sports and extracurriculars closer to where children live.
 



 Backed by leading investors including Accel, Matrix Partners and GSV, Openhouse has grown to
 



 12 learning centres across Bangalore, reaching 10,000\+ children through our centres and
 



 programs. We are now taking this experience beyond our centres and into the communities
 



 where families live.
 



  





 Over the last three months, we have already gone live in 12\+ apartments, bringing Openhouse's
 



 learning experiences directly into residential communities. This is just the beginning. Our
 



 ambition is to build a significant At Apartment and At Home presence across Bangalore, making
 



 high\-quality learning accessible without children having to travel across the city.
 



  





**Why sports?** 




  





**Sports will be one of the strongest pillars of this expansion.** 




  





 Apartments already have something that makes sports uniquely powerful — children, facilities and
 



 communities in one place. Whether it is a badminton court, football ground, swimming pool,
 



 skating area or multipurpose space, there is an opportunity to turn existing community
 



 infrastructure into a vibrant sporting ecosystem for children.
 



  





 But great sports programs need more than just a facility. They need great coaches, strong
 



 academies, consistent operations and, importantly, opportunities for children to compete and
 



 progress.
 



  





  





**That's where openhouse comes in.** 




  





 We want to build a sports network where a child can discover a sport, find a great coach, train
 



 consistently, participate in competitions and progress — all within or close to their own
 



 community.
 



  





**about the role Preschool \& Extracurriculars** 




 We are looking for a Sports Category Manager who can build this ecosystem from the ground up.
 



 This is not a conventional vendor\-management or operations role. You will be responsible for
 



 building the supply side of Openhouse Sports — creating relationships with individual coaches
 



 and academies, identifying and onboarding great talent, and building a network that allows us to
 



 launch sports programs rapidly across apartments.
 



  





  





 There will be three key ways in which we build our sports network:
 



  





**1\. Build the supply ourselves** 




 Where an apartment has a sports facility but no coach, identify the requirement, find the right
 



 coach and deploy them.
 



  





  





**2\. Partner with individual coaches** 




 Identify talented coaches who are currently teaching independently but may be looking for a
 



 better professional opportunity. Give them access to multiple apartments and take away the
 



 operational workload, allowing them to focus on what they do best — coaching children.
 



  





  





**3\. Partner with established academies** 




 Work with existing cricket, football, badminton, swimming, skating, karate and other sports
 



 academies to bring their best coaches into Openhouse communities. In return, help these
 



 academies expand their footprint across Bangalore without disrupting their existing coach\-
 



 student ecosystem.
 



  





  





 Alongside this, you will help build an Openhouse sports competition ecosystem — inter\-
 



 apartment tournaments, leagues and events that give children opportunities to compete, create
 



 stronger community engagement and make sports a long\-term habit.
 



  





**what you will own Preschool \& Extracurriculars** 



* Build a strong network of individual coaches across major sports.
* Identify and establish partnerships with leading sports academies across Bangalore.
* Build a ready\-to\-deploy pool of coaches for new apartment launches.
* Own coach identification, evaluation and onboarding.
* Work with existing apartment coaches and explore opportunities to bring them into the



 Openhouse ecosystem.
 


* Map apartment facilities and requirements to the right coaches/academies.
* Build and manage long\-term relationships with coaches and academy partners.
* Work with the broader Openhouse team to launch sports programs across apartments.
* Track coach quality, parent feedback, attendance and retention.
* Build a calendar of tournaments, leagues and inter\-apartment competitions.
* Develop relationships with sports communities, clubs, tournament organisers and other



 relevant ecosystem players.
 


* Work with the marketing team to leverage competitions and sporting events for community



 engagement and brand visibility.
 



  





**who we’re looking for** 



* 3–5\+ years of experience in sports management, sports operations, academy management,



 coaching networks or a similar role.
 


* Strong understanding of the Bangalore sports ecosystem.
* Existing relationships with coaches, academies, clubs, sporting organisations or tournament



 organisers will be a significant advantage.
 


* Ideally, someone with a strong sports background who understands coaching, coaches and



 the sporting ecosystem.
 


* Exposure to multiple sports — cricket, football, badminton, swimming, skating, karate, tennis,



 squash etc.
 


* Strong relationship\-building and negotiation skills.
* Someone who is comfortable getting out of the office, meeting coaches and academy owners



 and building relationships on the ground.
 


* Strong execution orientation and an entrepreneurial mindset.
* Experience organising tournaments, leagues, competitions or sports events is highly desirable.



  





**Bangalore\-based** 
 with a strong local network.
 



  





**Success Metrics** 



* Your success will not simply be measured by the number of coaches onboarded.
* We want you to build the foundation of a
 **scalable Openhouse Sports ecosystem:**



**Great coaches → Great programs → More apartments → More children playing → More** 




**competitions → Stronger retention.** 



* Over the first 6–12 months, you should help us build a strong coach and academy network



 across Bangalore, enable rapid sports launches across apartments and establish competitions
 



 as a core part of the Openhouse sports experience.
 


* Ultimately, the ambition is simple: Make openhouse the most trusted sports partner for



 children and families living in communities across Bangalore.
 



  





**the practical bits** 



* Location: Bangalore
* Experience: 3\-5\+ years
* Function: Category Lead, Sports
* Reporting to: Head of Business \& Revenue

title: Edge Computing Tech Lead

* The pride to work for a B Corp certified company and one of the world’s most trusted brands.

* **Feedback:** After interviews, we provide feedback to all candidates.
* **Job Offer:** Successful candidates will receive a formal offer.
* **First Working Day:** Once the offer is accepted, we’ll welcome you on your first day!

 **About Nespresso:**  

The Nespresso story began with a simple but revolutionary idea: enable anyone to create the perfect cup of espresso coffee.  

Since 1986, Nespresso has redefined and revolutionized the way millions of people enjoy their coffee.  

We are a Company committed with the Climate change and we aim to achieve carbon neutrality as soon as possible and net\-zero GHG emissions by 2050 at the latest.
In 2019 we created the digital hub in Barcelona to offer the best customer experience and innovation to B2C and B2B channels.  

*We encourage the diversity of applicants across gender, age, ethnicity, nationality, sexual orientation, social background, religion or belief and disability.*
People are at the heart of our success – all 14,000 of them. We actively cultivate diversity, inclusion and belonging in the workplace. We celebrate individuality, believing that your authenticity and uniqueness can help us to grow and thrive together
Step outside your comfort zone; share your ideas, way of thinking and working to make a difference to the world, every single day. You own a piece of the action – make it count.

Visa Sponsorship is not available for this position.

September 3, 2026 \- September 13, 2026

title: Senior Manager, Technical Services
description:
**Description**


**Who is USP?**


The U.S. Pharmacopeial Convention (USP) is an independent scientific organization that collaborates with the world’s leading health and science experts to develop rigorous quality standards for medicines, dietary supplements, and food ingredients. At USP, we believe that scientific excellence is driven by a commitment to fairness, integrity, and global collaboration. This belief is embedded in our core value of Passion for Quality and is demonstrated through the contributions of more than 1,300 professionals across twenty global locations, working to strengthen the supply of safe, high\-quality medicines worldwide.


At USP, we value inclusive scientific collaboration and recognize that attracting diverse expertise strengthens our ability to develop trusted public health standards. We foster an organizational culture that supports equitable access to mentorship, professional development, and leadership opportunities. Our partnerships, standards, and research reflect our belief that ensuring broad participation in scientific leadership results in stronger, more impactful outcomes for global health.


USP is proud to be an equal employment opportunity employer (EEOE) and is committed to ensuring fair, merit\-based selection processes that enable the best scientific minds—regardless of background—to contribute to advancing public health solutions worldwide. We provide reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities and uphold policies that create an inclusive and collaborative work environment.


**Brief Job Overview**


The Sr. Manager, Technical Services Support (India) is a strategic people leadership role responsible for overseeing the India\-based Technical Services team and supporting the continued growth and evolution of USP's global Technical Services function. This position plays a critical role in ensuring the delivery of high\-quality scientific product/service inquiry support, operational excellence, and an exceptional customer experience while fostering a high\-performing, customer\-centric culture.


The role operates within a matrixed leadership structure, functionally reporting to the Senior Director, Customer Success \& Operations (US\-based) and administratively reporting to the Director, Scientific Affairs (India\-based). The incumbent will provide direct people leadership and administrative oversight for the India\-based Technical Services team while partnering closely with the US\-based Senior Manager, Technical Services Operations, who provides functional direction related to service delivery processes, performance standards, and inquiry management activities.


As USP continues to expand its global service delivery capabilities, this role is expected to evolve in scope and strategic impact, contributing to organizational scaling efforts, talent development, operational excellence initiatives, knowledge management, process optimization, workforce planning, and the advancement of global scientific and product/service support capabilities.


The Sr. Manager will collaborate extensively with stakeholders across Customer Success \& Operations, Strategic Customer Development, Scientific Affairs, Quality Assurance, Customer Service, Reference Material Support, Reference Standards Technical Operations, Reference Standards Production, Distribution, Reference Standards Evaluation, Legal, Documentary Standards and Compendial Policy, Global Biologics, and other cross\-functional teams located in both the United States and India.


The primary working shift for this position is 2:00 PM – 10:30 PM IST.


**How will YOU create impact here at USP?**


As part of our mission to advance scientific rigor and public health standards, you will play a vital role in increasing global access to high\-quality medicines through public standards and related programs. USP prioritizes scientific integrity, regulatory excellence, and evidence\-based decision\-making to ensure health systems worldwide can rely on strong, tested, and globally relevant quality standards.


Additionally, USP’s People and Culture division, in partnership with the Equity Office, invests in leadership and workforce development to equip all employees with the skills to create high\-performing, inclusive teams. This includes training in equitable management practices and tools to promote engaged, collaborative, and results\-driven work environments.


The Sr. Manager, Technical Services Support role has the following responsibilities:


**Key Responsibilities**


**People Leadership \& Team Management**


* Provide leadership, guidance, direction, and administrative oversight to the India\-based Technical Services team, fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, continuous improvement, and customer\-centricity.
* Integrate employee engagement principles into daily leadership practices to cultivate a high\-performing, motivated, and inclusive team environment, led by example through visible leadership and active coaching.
* Manage all aspects of employee performance, including goal setting, communicating job expectations, performance evaluations, coaching, mentoring, career development, recognition, corrective action, and succession planning.
* Partner with the Customer Success and Operations leadership team to support workforce planning, talent acquisition, onboarding, employee retention, and capability development initiatives as the Technical Services organization continues to evolve and expand.
* Ensure team members have access to the appropriate resources, tools, training, and support required to effectively perform their responsibilities.

**Service Delivery \& Operational Excellence**


* Partner closely with the Senior Manager, Technical Services Operations, who provides the functional strategy and strategic direction for the Global Technical Services, to effectively execute and operationalize the Technical Services operating model within India.
* Translate established strategies, processes, policies, procedures, training programs, and service delivery standards into consistent day\-to\-day execution, ensuring high\-quality, efficient, and scalable service delivery.
* Provide local operational leadership, monitor performance and adherence to standards, and identify opportunities for continuous improvement that strengthen team effectiveness, service quality, and overall customer experience.
* Ensure adherence to applicable USP Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), Department Controlled Documents, Operational Manuals, quality requirements such as audit readiness, and regulatory expectations.
* Monitor team performance against established service levels, quality standards, productivity goals, and customer experience objectives, implementing corrective actions and continuous improvement initiatives as needed.
* Utilize operational data, performance metrics, and customer feedback to identify trends, opportunities, and risks that support ongoing optimization of the Technical Services function.
* Support organizational initiatives focused on operational scalability, process harmonization, knowledge management, and service excellence.

**Scientific Inquiry Management \& Quality Oversight**


* Maintain a strong understanding of USP products, services, scientific resources, and customer support processes to effectively lead and support the team.
* Remain proficient in the functionality and use of Salesforce, including the Case Management Module and related service technologies.
* Conduct case quality reviews and quality assurance assessments for both US\- and India\-based Technical Services team members to ensure consistency, accuracy, and compliance with established standards.
* Support the development and maintenance of knowledge assets, best practices, training materials, and quality improvement initiatives that enhance inquiry resolution effectiveness.
* Serve as a first point of escalation and directly manage customer inquiries as needed based on business demands, inquiry complexity, volume fluctuations, or resource requirements.

**Cross\-Functional Partnership \& Strategic Support**


* Collaborate with Customer Success \& Operations, Scientific Affairs, Quality Assurance, Customer Service, Legal, Distribution, Global Science teams, and other cross\-functional stakeholders to support customer and organizational objectives.
* Facilitate effective communication and alignment between India\-based team members and global stakeholders, helping to ensure consistency in service delivery and execution.
* Contribute to the continued evolution of USP's global Technical Services operating model by identifying opportunities to enhance team capabilities, operational effectiveness, and customer outcomes.
* Participate in special projects, strategic initiatives, organizational transformation efforts, and other duties as assigned, supporting the long\-term growth and maturity of the Technical Services function.

**Who is USP Looking For?**


The successful candidate will have a demonstrated understanding of our mission, commitment to excellence through inclusive and equitable behaviors and practices, ability to quickly build credibility with stakeholders, along with the following competencies and experience:


* Master's degree in chemistry or relevant scientific field
* Minimum of ten (12\) years of experience in the pharmaceutical field, which includes hands\-on experience and expertise in chromatography, spectroscopy, and other analytical testing methods.
* Minimum of 2 years of management experience.
* Must demonstrate a strong customer\-centric mindset with a consistent focus on delivering high\-quality service, responsiveness, and customer satisfaction in a regulated or technical environment.
* Must have experience translating scientific or technical expertise into effective customer support, issue resolution, and service excellence outcomes within cross\-functional teams.
* Must be willing to work in 2:00 PM – 10:30 PM IST shift.

**Additional Desired Preferences**


* Willingness to travel to USP–Rockville for initial training purposes for approximately 2–4 weeks
* Knowledge of USP standards\-setting processes, compendial terminology, USP Documentary Standards, and USP reference materials
* Familiarity with laboratory workflows and ability to interpret customer issues related to reference materials and analytical testing to support effective resolution
* Ability to multitask, prioritize, and manage a high volume of work in a fast\-paced environment while maintaining accuracy and attention to detail
* Strong organizational and problem\-solving skills with the ability to manage competing priorities effectively
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a matrixed, global team environment
* Ability to maintain composure, professionalism, and positive engagement in high\-pressure or time\-sensitive situations
* Willingness and ability to work flexible and/or extended hours when required to support global operations and customer needs
* Sufficient typing skills to support efficient case documentation and system usage
* Preferred but not required: experience using Salesforce CRM or similar case management systems

**Supervisory Responsibilities**


Will lead a team of 5 scientists responsible for managing customer inquiries related to USP Documentary Standards and USP Physical Materials.


**Benefits**


USP provides the benefits to protect yourself and your family today and tomorrow. From company\-paid time off and comprehensive healthcare options to retirement savings, you can have peace of mind that your personal and financial well\-being is protected.


Note: USP does not accept unsolicited resumes from 3rd party recruitment agencies and is not responsible for fees from recruiters or other agencies except under specific written agreement with USP.


**Job Category** Chemistry \& Scientific Standards


**Job Type** Full\-Time

title: Senior Manager, Customer Experience
description:
**Organization Overview**
**Company Description**
**QAD** 
 is a leading provider of ERP solutions purpose\-built for manufacturing industries — automotive, life sciences, food \& beverage, high tech, and industrial. Serving thousands of global manufacturers, QAD's Adaptive Manufacturing Cloud helps companies operate with greater precision, agility, and intelligence.
   

  

 Enterprise software is entering a third era. The first gave manufacturers a System of Record — ERP that answered 'what do we have and what did we commit to?' The second gave them Data Infrastructure — the ability to move, analyse, and query that data at scale. The third era is domain\-specific intelligence: AI agents that can act autonomously on manufacturing data, but only if that data has been given the context, relationships, and governed rules that allow an agent to reason correctly.
   

  

**ERA — QAD's Enterprise Resource Allocation platform —** 
 is the domain intelligence layer that sits between any ERP and any AI agent. It encodes what manufacturing data means, governs what agents are permitted to do, and makes every autonomous decision traceable and accountable.
   

  

 Shift Timing: 2:00 PM – 11:00 PM IST
   

  

**Job Description**
 As the
 **Senior Manager, Customer Experience (Cloud Operations)** 
 , you will serve as a critical operational pillar within QAD’s global Cloud Operations organization, reporting directly to the Senior Director of Cloud Operations. In this high\-visibility leadership role, you will bridge strategic cloud direction with world\-class operational delivery.
   

  

 You will lead QAD’s IT Service Management (ITSM) framework, own major incident and problem resolution lifecycle, drive change management, and serve as the primary operational QAD interface for our outsourced Managed Service Provider (MSP) partner. Your core mission is to ensure secure, highly available, and performant AWS cloud infrastructure that delivers an exceptional, seamless customer experience for QAD's enterprise SaaS clients.
   

  

**Role Division \& Core Focus Areas**
 60% — IT Service Management \& Governance \| \| (Incident \& Problem Management, SLA Enforcement, MSP Governance)
   

  

 40% — AWS Cloud Ops, FinOps \& Release \| \| (AWS Infrastructure, Change Advisory, Release Management)
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Incident \& Problem Management Leadership
* Major Incident Command: Own the end\-to\-end lifecycle for P0, P1, and P2 incidents. Serve as the incident commander leading war room discussions, managing real\-time bridge calls, establishing stakeholder communication discipline, and driving swift resolution.
* Root Cause Analysis (RCA) \& Quality: Oversee rigorous RCA documentation and track permanent fixes to completion to eliminate repeat failures across complex cloud environments.
* Incident Protocol Enforcement: Maintain war room discipline, enforce post\-incident review SLAs, and ensure compliance with P0 real\-time handling protocols.
* Service Delivery \& SLA Governance
* SLA Performance: Own weekly SLA breach analyses and strictly enforce Response and Resolution SLA tiers (P0–P3\) across both internal teams and vendor partners.
* Queue \& Ticket Hygiene: Drive daily ticket health reviews, enforce priority accuracy, eliminate stalled tickets (e.g., "waiting on customer" discipline), and manage inactive P1/P2 queues.
* Executive Reporting: Deliver weekly operational SLA trend analysis and performance metrics to the Senior Director of Cloud Operations.
* MSP \& Outsourced Partner Governance
* Primary Partner Interface: Act as QAD’s daily operational interface for our outsourced managed services partner, collaborating directly with their Principal Engineering Manager level.
* Scope \& SLA Governance: Oversee Statement of Work (SOW) compliance, chair regular scope reviews, and strictly prevent out\-of\-scope creep in both directions. Hold the MSP accountable to contractual SLAs via weekly BAU tracker reviews.
* Formal Reviews \& RACI: Lead monthly formal service reviews and mandate actionable, written improvement plans for any SLA breaches. Maintain and enforce incident/change RACI matrices across QAD and MSP teams.
* Cutover \& Release Alignment: Oversee pre\-UAT and production cutover handovers with clear RACI framework execution, staffing confirmations, and standardized communication templates.
* Change Advisory \& Cloud Release Management
* CAB Leadership: Chair the Change Advisory Board (CAB) process, ensuring all high\-risk changes feature detailed rollback plans and clear go/no\-go criteria.
* Release Coordination: Maintain the global change calendar, coordinating seamlessly between cloud migrations, monthly patch releases, and MSP deployments.


**Qualifications**
**Qualifications \& Experience**
**Must\-Have Requirements**
* Experience: 12\+ years of total experience in Cloud/IT Operations, with 5\+ years specifically in ITSM or Service Delivery leadership roles.
* Incident Leadership: Proven track record in P0/P1 major incident command at enterprise scale.
* ITSM Mastery: Deep expertise in ITIL framework—specifically Incident, Problem, Change, SLA, and Supplier Management.
* Vendor/MSP Governance: Hands\-on experience governing third\-party MSPs or outsourced service partners (scope management, contractual SLAs, performance reviews).
* Cross\-Team RACI: Experience establishing and enforcing live incident/change RACI frameworks across combined internal and vendor teams.
* People Leadership \& Hours: 3\+ years of direct people management experience. Flexibility to work overlapping US East / EMEA business hours (approx. 2:00 PM – 11:00 PM IST) from Pune.
* Technical Depth: Solid experience with SaaS\-hosted infrastructure, Linux/Windows server administration, and AWS cloud operations.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Certifications: ITIL v4 Foundation or Managing Professional; AWS Certified SysOps Administrator or Cloud Practitioner; FinOps Certified Practitioner (FinOps Foundation).
* Tools: Hands\-on working knowledge of enterprise ITSM platforms like ServiceNow, Jira Service Management, or Zendesk.
* Domain Knowledge: Background in Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) SaaS hosting or manufacturing software environments.
* Vendor Background: Direct experience managing tier\-1 Indian IT services delivery partners (e.g., Persistent, Infosys, Wipro, HCL, or similar).
* AWS Expertise: Hands\-on working knowledge of core AWS services (EC2, EBS, VPC, IAM, S3, RDS, Security Groups, VPN, CloudWatch).


**Additional Information**

* Opportunity to join a growing business, launching into its next phase of expansion and transformation.
* Collaborative culture of smart and hard\-working people who support one another to get the job done.

With three core pillars — Redzone (frontline empowerment), Adaptive Applications (the intelligent backbone), and Champion AI (Agentic AI for manufacturing) — QAD \| Redzone helps manufacturers operate with Champion Pace, achieving measurable productivity, resilience, and growth in just 90 days.

### **Description**

  

As a Change Manager, you will play a key role in ensuring that organizational projects and initiatives meet objectives on time and on budget by increasing employee adoption and usage of the Change Management processes. This person focuses on the people and process side of change, which involves preparing, supporting, and equipping people to adopt and use the change process to help reduce and manage risk.  

  

The change manager will work closely with Technical IT Delivery, Security, Service Operations and line of business teams to ensure new teams and businesses are onboarded to the change process, adhere to policies and work with Group IT to facilitate and provide visibility of IT Changes. The management and execution of Change Management will be through the ServiceNow platform.### **Key Responsibilities**

  

* Ownership of the IT Change Management Process ensuring continual improvement.
* Ensure adherence to the Change Management Process supporting BAU, Project and 3rd Party changes.
* Conduct impact analyses, assess change readiness and identify key stakeholders.
* Identify and manage anticipated resistance to adhere to the change process.

title: Customer Success Specialist (B2B AI SaaS)
description:
**About the role** 




  





 You'll be the person who takes a signed client from "we just bought this" to "this is running and driving results." At JoyzAI, that means standing up their AI chatbot and AI calling agents end\-to\-end — building the knowledge base, configuring the agent's behaviour, wiring up the lead and CRM flows, and then staying with them so the product actually delivers.
 



  





 This is not a ticket\-closing role. It's a build\-and\-own role. You're technical enough to configure agents yourself, and human enough to make clients feel taken care of at every step. You delight customers by solving the real problem, not by marking a query "resolved."
 



  





 What you'll do
 



  





**Onboarding \& agent setup** 



* Own new\-client onboarding from kickoff to go\-live: scope the use case, gather source material, and set clear delivery timelines.
* Build and structure knowledge bases from client content (websites, brochures, PDFs, FAQs) so the AI answers accurately and on\-brand.
* Configure AI chatbot and AI calling agents across the platform — Tasks, Access, Behaviour, and AI Config — including prompt design, conversation flows, guardrails, and tone (including Hinglish where needed).
* Set up CRM contact fields, ticket types, and automated workflows so leads and conversations route correctly.
* Configure voice agent call handling — greetings, one\-question\-per\-turn flows, voicemail/no\-answer/silence fallbacks, and WhatsApp follow\-ups for links and addresses.



  





**Integrations \& data flow** 



* Wire up lead pipelines — e.g. Meta lead forms → Joyz webhook, Google Sheets automations — and validate that phone/contact data lands clean and deduplicated.
* Coordinate WhatsApp Business API setup with clients (WABA, embedded signup, number provisioning) and troubleshoot access or restriction issues.
* Assist with booking, calendar, and payment integrations where the client's flow requires them.



  





**Ongoing success** 



* Run demos, walkthroughs, and handover sessions so clients can self\-serve confidently.
* Monitor live agent performance, catch weak answers or broken flows, and iterate on prompts and KB content.
* Troubleshoot issues technically before escalating — reproduce, diagnose, and fix where you can.
* Track client health, drive adoption, and surface expansion or churn signals to the team.



  





 Roughly 75% of your time is hands\-on build: software configuration, AI agent design, and API integrations into whatever the client already runs. CRM, ERP, Google Sheets, calendars, WhatsApp, and the odd internal tool nobody has documented.
 



  





 The other 25% is sitting with the client, understanding how their business actually works, and figuring out where our software can move a number that matters to them.
 



  





 That split shifts as the product matures. Expect it to land closer to 60/40 within two years, with more of your time spent on the thinking and less on the plumbing.
 



  





 We're under 15 people building AI calling agents. This is not a comfortable corporate job. You'll be in the trenches, you'll work hard, and you'll compress ten years of ordinary career growth into two (this means salary growth also, not just more work).
 



  





**What We’re Looking For** 




  





 We don't care too much about experience or degree as long as you have what it takes to do the job.
 



  





**Why JoyzAI?** 




 ✨
 **Utmost freedom and autonomy** 
 — to make decisions. You are the taskmaster, do it the way you think is best. We will only suggest.
 



 ✨
 **Complete responsibility** 
 . You are the taskmaster. Take responsibility for it.
 



 ✨
 **Top\-of\-the\-market pay** 
 – we reward high performance with the best packages.
 



 ✨
 **5\-day working** 
 – weekends are yours to recharge.
 



 ✨
 **Work from office in Noida** 
 – collaborate, learn, and grow with a passionate team.
 



 ✨
 **High\-growth startup** 
 – opportunity to be see first hand how AI brings change and be a part of that.

**About the Function** 




 MyBiz, a corporate travel management platform by MakeMyTrip provides a customizable, real time self\-booking system which seamlessly integrates into a company’s structure to deliver convenience, transparency, savings and the power of choice.
 



  





 Over last 5 years, they have on\-boarded 50000\+ prominent corporates which are availing the benefits of our seamless platform, along with significant savings.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 As a KAM Lead for the MyBiz business at MakeMyTrip, this role will own and scale the corporate account management charter across the North region. The role is responsible for driving regional growth through strong client relationships, revenue expansion, and consistent delivery of business outcomes across enterprise and mid\-market accounts.
 



  





 This role will lead and develop a high\-performing KAM team, own end\-to\-end regional targets, and ensure operational rigor across account management, renewals, and upsell. The focus will be on building long\-term partnerships with corporates, improving client satisfaction, and driving disciplined execution while fostering a culture of ownership, collaboration, and continuous improvement
 



  





**What will you be doing** 




  





**1\. Strategic Leadership \& Growth** 



* Define and execute the regional corporate account strategy to deliver revenue growth, profitability, and market share across the North region.
* Translate overall business objectives into clear regional priorities, action plans, and measurable KPIs.
* Drive data\-led decision\-making by analysing market trends, competitive landscape, customer behaviour, and funnel performance.



**2\. Team Leadership \& Development** 



* Lead, mentor, and scale a team of 8 Key Account Managers (KAMs) across the region. Set clear performance expectations, targets, and incentive frameworks to drive consistent outcomes.
* Enable the team through structured training, sales playbooks, deal\-closing frameworks, and forecasting discipline.
* Build a high\-performance culture anchored in ownership, collaboration, and continuous improvement.



**3\. Sales Delivery \& Pipeline Management** 



* Own the end\-to\-end sales cycle for mid to large enterprise accounts, from lead engagement and solutioning to closure.
* Ensure a healthy, predictable, and revenue\-backed pipeline across MyBiz offerings, including the Self\-Booking Tool, managed travel services, and Travel \& Expense solutions.
* Identify and drive upsell, cross\-sell, and renewal opportunities to maximize account value and long\-term revenue.



**4\. Client Relationship \& Value Delivery** 



* Act as the strategic relationship owner and escalation point for key corporate clients in the region.
* Drive high customer satisfaction through strong account governance, seamless onboarding, and effective support coordination.
* Partner closely with Product, Operations, Finance, Legal, and Delivery teams to ensure smooth implementation and contractual adherence.



**5\. Market \& Competitive Intelligence** 



* Track regional market dynamics to identify emerging sectors, solution gaps, pricing trends, and competitive moves.
* Refine the regional go\-to\-market strategy on an ongoing basis using insights from market data and performance metrics.



**6\. Cross\-functional Collaboration** 



* Work closely with Product and Supply teams to strengthen offerings and address evolving client needs.
* Partner with Finance to enable accurate forecasting, revenue tracking, and business optimization.
* Coordinate with Operations and Technology teams to ensure efficient onboarding, service delivery, and issue resolution.
* Engage with Legal teams to manage contract lifecycles, ensure compliance, and mitigate commercial risk



  





**Qualification \& Experience:** 



* Post\-graduate from a reputed institute with 8–12 years of experience in corporate sales or account management, including 2–3 years in a people leadership role.
* Strong experience in B2B SaaS or tech\-enabled platform sales; exposure to corporate travel technology or enterprise solutions is preferred.
* Demonstrated track record of consistently exceeding targets, scaling teams, and driving regional growth.
* Strong comfort with P\&L ownership, pricing levers, funnel economics, and sales forecasting



  





**Key Success Factors for the Role:** 



* **Business Acumen:** 
 Strong commercial and strategic mindset with the ability to assess market dynamics, revenue opportunities, and business risk.
* **Analytical Rigor:** 
 Data\-driven approach to tracking pipeline health, sales efficiency, and revenue outcomes, with clear ownership of targets and productivity metrics.
* **Communication \& Negotiation:** 
 Clear and confident communicator with the ability to influence and negotiate effectively at senior and CXO levels.
* **Execution Focus:** 
 Strong bias for action with a consistent track record of delivering revenue targets and improving sales cycle efficiency.
* **Customer Orientation:** 
 Focus on long\-term account growth and retention through value\-led solutions and strong client partnerships.

 Ability to build and scale high\-performing teams through coaching, accountability, and stakeholder collaboration.

title: Chief Operating Officer (COO) – ReUnited India
description:
Chief Operating Officer (COO) – ReUnited India

**Location:** Delhi NCR, India  
**Job Type:** Full\-Time  
**Experience:** 5–10\+ years  
**Department:** Leadership / Business Operations  
**Reports To:** Founder \& CEO

About ReUnited

ReUnited is a B2B platform transforming the way real estate brokers operate, collaborate and grow.

Our vision is to move brokers from a traditional **“Property Dealer” mindset to a “Real Estate Portfolio Manager” mindset**, while building a strong professional network, business opportunity ecosystem, knowledge platform and technology\-enabled operating environment for the real estate community.

As we scale across cities and build a national network, we are looking for a **Chief Operating Officer (COO)** to build and lead the operating engine of the business.

About the Role

The COO will work directly with the Founder \& CEO and will be responsible for **turning strategy into execution, building scalable systems, driving business growth and creating a high\-performance organisation.**

This is not a traditional administrative operations role.

We are looking for a commercially driven operator who can bring together **people, processes, technology, data and execution** to build a scalable and profitable business.

Key areas of ownership:

* Business operations and cross\-functional execution
* Membership growth and revenue operations
* Member onboarding, engagement and retention
* Sales and CRM performance
* Team productivity and performance management
* SOP and process development
* Technology, automation and reporting
* Events and broker community initiatives
* City/franchise operations
* Financial and operational discipline
* Management dashboards and business performance

Key ResponsibilitiesBusiness Operations \& Execution

* Translate the Founder \& CEO's strategy into annual, quarterly and monthly operating plans.
* Establish clear KRAs, KPIs and accountability across functions.
* Build and manage a strong weekly and monthly operating cadence.
* Track business performance and ensure timely execution.
* Identify operational bottlenecks and drive cross\-functional solutions.
* Build systems that reduce dependency on Founder\-led day\-to\-day execution.

Growth \& Revenue Operations

* Build a predictable membership growth and revenue engine.
* Optimise the complete funnel: **Lead → Qualification → Audit/Demo → Conversion → Onboarding → Engagement → Renewal → Referral.**
* Establish sales targets, conversion benchmarks and pipeline reviews.
* Improve CRM adoption, sales productivity and follow\-up discipline.
* Work with the marketing and sales teams to improve lead quality and conversion.
* Track metrics such as leads, conversion %, revenue, pipeline, CAC, revenue/member, renewal and churn.

Member Success \& Retention

* Own the overall member lifecycle and member experience.
* Build structured onboarding and 30\-60\-90 day member success programs.
* Establish systems to monitor member engagement and identify at\-risk members.
* Develop strategies to improve retention, renewals and referrals.
* Establish member satisfaction and NPS measurement.
* Create processes to understand and reduce member churn.

Events \& Community

* Own the operational and commercial performance of ReUnited broker meets and events.
* Develop event processes, targets and performance metrics.
* Build a structured **Event → Prospect → Membership** conversion process.
* Track registrations, attendance, leads, conversions and event ROI.

City \& Franchise Operations

* Build scalable systems for launching and managing ReUnited across cities.
* Develop city\-level KPIs and reporting.
* Standardise onboarding, training and operating processes for city partners.
* Monitor city performance and create improvement plans for underperforming locations.
* Ensure a consistent ReUnited member experience across markets.

Technology, CRM \& Automation

* Drive effective adoption of ReUnited's technology platform and CRM.
* Build dashboards that provide real\-time visibility into business performance.
* Identify opportunities for automation and AI\-driven productivity.

title: New-ADN-Sr. Manager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**EY\- Assurance – Senior Manager**
 As part of our EY\-Assurance Team, you would be the main point of contact from GDS for the tasks assigned by the global client serving assurance teams and be responsible for the timeliness and quality of deliverables along with managing day to day operations of those engagements.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 We’re looking for individual who should have Assurance related experience in the Asset Management industry.
   

  

 In addition to supporting the management of service delivery for several key clients, the incumbent should have the potential to coach managers in the Asset Management segment, provide technical support, deliver industry training and assist in growing the Asset Management practice.
   

  

**Your key responsibilitie**
**Manage and develop people**
* Be an effective manager by empowering, monitoring, coaching and motivating the team members.
* Identify development opportunities and training needs for high performing managers.
* Identify technical and non–technical training needs with respect to client servicing, decision making, people issues, etc
* Conduct Assurance team’s performance reviews, serve as a positive leader and mentor, and play a significant role in the team’s performance


**Manage business and clients**
* Develop and maintain strong relationship network with key contacts in the Asset Management sector of engagement teams
* Actively support the Sector agenda both in terms of growth and quality initiatives (e.g. improvement of service delivery, standardization of projects, new solutions, etc.)
* Enhance connectivity between GDS team and engagement teams and leverage good connections to identify more opportunities for work
* Actively support the communication agenda for the Asset Management sector
* Support the Segment Leader in developing annual growth, resource and activity plans
* Monitor KPIs (growth, quality feedback, utilization, risk management compliance, attrition, etc.) for the teams under supervision and take appropriate action wherever required


**Manage quality of service delivery**
* Identify sector–specific training needs, review and update current curriculum
* Assist in organizing and providing technical training (both Sector and Assurance methodology)
* Assist in addressing service delivery quality issues if and when they occur
* Support exceptional service delivery action programs
* Establish a practice of ‘Best Practice’ sharing within the Asset Management Segment teams


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Expert knowledge of Indian accounting and assurance standards
* Asset Management, assurance experience with specific focus on Hedge Funds and Private Equity
* Effective interpersonal, risk management, facilitation and presentation skills
* Project management, leadership, coaching, counselling and supervisory skills
* Strong project and people management skills with experience in serving global clients
* Strong verbal and written communication skills in English


**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* Qualified Chartered Accountant (ICAI) / CPA/ACCA)
* Approximately over 10 years of Assurance relevant experience with well\-known CA firms.
* International experience of over 2 years will be an added advantage


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* Proficiency in MS – Excel, MS – Office.
* Interest in business and commerciality.


**What We Look For**
* A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast\-moving environment
* An opportunity to be a part of market\-leading, multi\-disciplinary team in the only integrated global assurance business worldwide.
* Opportunities to work with EY GDS Assurance practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries


**What We Offer**
 EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well\-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever\-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
   

  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Relationship Manager
description:
**Company Description** 
 GCL Dreams is part of GCL, one of India’s leading diversified financial services groups, promoted by a family with decades of experience in financial markets. As a member of major exchanges such as NSE, BSE, MCX, and NCDEX, GCL offers robust online and offline platforms for investing, hedging, and trading. The organization focuses on delivering expert financial services tailored to clients’ present and future needs. GCL has grown from an entrepreneurial start\-up to a market leader by adapting to changing market conditions while maintaining a strong focus on its core financial services domain.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Relationship Manager is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Ahmedabad. This role is responsible for building, managing, and strengthening relationships with existing and prospective clients across GCL Dreams’ financial products and services. Day\-to\-day activities include understanding client goals, recommending suitable investment and trading solutions, addressing queries, and ensuring timely resolution of service issues. The Relationship Manager will regularly follow up with clients, assist with account opening and documentation, and coordinate with internal teams to deliver a seamless client experience. The role also involves identifying new business opportunities, meeting defined sales and retention targets, and maintaining accurate records of client interactions and portfolios.
   

**Qualifications**
  

* Strong client relationship management skills, including ability to build trust, understand client needs, and provide tailored financial solutions.
* Solid communication and interpersonal skills to explain financial products clearly and handle client queries professionally.
* Basic to intermediate knowledge of capital markets, trading, and investment products; prior experience in financial services or brokerage is an advantage.
* Proficiency in using CRM tools, MS Office, and online trading or investment platforms.
* Ability to work towards sales and retention targets, with good negotiation and problem\-solving skills.
* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Commerce, Business Administration, Economics, or a related field; relevant certifications (e.g., NISM) are beneficial.
* High level of integrity, attention to detail, and a customer\-centric mindset.
* Comfort working in an on\-site environment in Ahmedabad and collaborating with cross\-functional teams.

 We are looking for a Customer Success Intern who is passionate about technology and enjoys interacting with customers. This internship offers hands\-on exposure to customer onboarding, product implementation, technical troubleshooting, and product testing while working closely with the Customer Success and Product teams.This is an excellent opportunity for students or recent graduates looking to build a career in Customer Success, Solutions Engineering, or Product.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




  




* Customer SuccessAssist in onboarding new customers and ensuring a smooth implementation experience.
* Conduct product walkthroughs and training sessions.
* Support customers via email, chat, and virtual meetings.
* Help customers understand product features and best practices.
* Build strong relationships by providing timely support.
* Technical Support:Troubleshoot basic technical and product\-related issues.
* Reproduce reported bugs and document findings.
* Coordinate with the Product and Engineering teams for issue resolution.
* Maintain accurate records of customer queries and resolutions.
* Product Testing \& Quality:Test newly developed features before release.
* Execute test cases and report bugs with detailed documentation.
* Verify bug fixes and ensure product quality.
* Suggest usability improvements based on customer feedback.
* Documentation:Create user guides, FAQs, and knowledge base articles.
* Maintain implementation and troubleshooting documentation.
* Document customer feedback and feature requests.



  





**Requirements:** 




  




* Pursuing or recently completed a Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
* Excellent analytical and problem\-solving abilities.
* Basic understanding of APIs, JSON, SQL, or web technologies is a plus.
* Quick learner with a customer\-first mindset.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast\-paced startup environment.



  





**Preferred Skills:** 




  




* Good verbal and written communication.
* Strong attention to detail.
* Basic knowledge of software testing concepts.
* Familiarity with Excel/Google Sheets.
* Interest in SaaS products and customer\-facing roles.
